style_when: the story is a single number, a single rule, or a single shift — and restraint is the point rather than a scene
prompt: Minimalist flat composition, one large solid rectangular block resting on two smaller wedges, but one wedge is missing or removed, causing a deliberate asymmetry and imbalance. Two or three flat colours from a muted palette of slate grey and terracotta, hard edges, generous negative space, gallery-print calm.
negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, wordmarks, signage, UI, light bulb, handshake, chess, puzzle piece, glowing brain, rocket, dartboard, scales of justice, gavel, thumbs up, people, texture, 3D shading
rationale: The story is about a single hard rule—a validation-and-rollback gate—and the severe numerical consequence (a 62% drop) of removing it. A minimal geometry treatment perfectly captures this structural shift and the idea of dropping one critical check.
subject: a large geometric block missing a single critical supporting wedge
alt_text: A large geometric block tilting slightly because a supporting wedge has been removed.
caption: Multi-agent systems rely on validation gates to function; dropping them causes performance to collapse.
title: Minimal geometry representing a dropped hard check
